text_id: (Part 2) One benefit of being on campus during the weekends was a distinct lack of faculty or students prowling its commons. A perfect setting for a showdown between the Hall of Heroes and the Vile Villains, patent pending. Ruby giggled as she watched her sister, no... Flamous, the showy hero with an obsession for fire, strut her way proudly onto the battlefield. Snow Angel was in tow and her pout was in full effect, meaning today would be a tremendous battle indeed! Mr. Awesome... Ruby snickered seeing the underwear again, looked nauseous even as the Horrific Hammer set him on his feet. "So, ready to give up yet?" gloated Yang. "In your dreams! You heroes are going down today!" Ruby shouted back. It was deigned a 'team building exercise' by Ruby and Yang. In reality it was little more than two sisters living out a ridiculous fantasy and replicating a childhood past time. Now with more people to drag into it! Hooray for friends! Ruby suppressed a snicker and held a hand out, signaling for her weapons. A water gun weighed heavily in her palm and she slung it over her shoulder with a grin. "Last chance to back out, Flamous." Yang snorted and twirled dual squirt guns in her hands. "Fat chance, Cookie Bum! What's wrong? Are we too hot to handle for you? Afraid you're gonna get burned?" She wasn't afraid! They were villains, villains weren't afraid of anything! They did bad stuff like... Steal candy from babies, and scowl at puppies. Except Zwei. She'd never scowl at Zwei! "Um... Yeah, well you're... Your face!" Victory. Ruby huffed and looked to her evil cohort for help. "Uh, guys...?" Blake shrugged and Ren simply stared ahead, either thinking or waiting for the inevitable scuffle. "Um... You'll..." Pyrrha began, tapping her chin. "Oh, I know!" She smiled brightly. "Our victory will be Phyrric!" "Are you saying we're going to lose...?" Blake asked. "What? Oh, no! I'm sorry!" "Enough talk, villains!" Nora stormed forward and leveled her water gun at Ruby with a wide grin. "Today's the day you bow down to us, the League of Awesome!" Ren tilted his head. "I thought you were the Hall of Heroes?" "Noooo! Renny, I mean, Silent Death," Nora amended. "That's our hideout's name! We're the League of Awesome!" "Wait, does that make me the leader?" Jaune asked. "If Jaune is the leader then I formally submit my resignation," Weiss grumbled. "Arrrgh, enough of this! Let's get it on already!" Yang smiled wildly and aimed her pistols. "Time to fry, villains!" "In your wildest dreams, hero scum!" Ruby squeaked indignantly. What ensued would be a battle retold throughout the ages. Water guns were fired, balloons were popped. Jaune's were ridden into battle and subsequently hurled across the commons, then used again as battering rams. Weiss threatened to sue her friends, though everyone knew it was a hollow threat. By the time all 'ammunition' was exhausted, as were all eight combatants, a small crowd had gathered to watch the display. Ruby would fondly remember the majesty of what would be their greatest triumph. Or so she thought. "Hah... Give up, heroes. You're finished..." Ruby panted, hands on her knees. Water dripped from her drenched bangs and she grimaced, pulling at her soaked shirt. Yang's eyes flickered red but she reigned in her anger. Her poor hair... "N-Never! This is your end, evildoers! We still have our secret weapon!" Ruby stood upright with a start and whined. "What?! You're heroes, you shouldn't have secret weapons! That's a villain thing!" Undeterred Yang waved Nora forward and grinned maliciously. "Tough luck! I knew you'd try something underhanded, so I took the liberty of making something too! You're finished!" "Wh-wha... No, we have something too! It's... Uh..." Ruby looked around frantically then whipped around and grabbed Blake by the shoulders, shaking her. "Shadow, where's our secret weapon?!" Between her groans and growls Blake managed to say 'I don't know', stumbling and pushing Ruby's hands off her. Yang cleared her throat and smirked, swinging Ruby's bag from her left hand, her own in her right. "Check and mate. You're finished!" A few of those in the crowd cheered, having gotten into whatever absurdity was unfolding before them. Most were just confused. Ruby whined and flapped her arms uselessly, looking to her allies for help. Pyrrha was busy fretting over Jaune and plucking bits of bark from his hair. Ren was utterly exhausted in no small part thanks to Nora, and Blake was... Blake. They couldn't lose! Losing meant... "Game over, Rubes!" Yang grinned and pulled out two water balloons stuffed with meat sauce stolen from the cafeteria. It happened in slow motion, and in that moment Ruby saw her life flash before her eyes. She was too young, too innocent! There was still so much for her to do! Oh wait, Semblances. Ruby wove between the balloons with ease and grinned, standing tall, hands on her hips. "Hah, you missed!" Yang seemed frustrated, then in a surprising twist, horrified. Weiss' eyes were wide and she covered her mouth with her hands, while Nora roared with laughter. What was everyone so shocked about? Ruby tilted her head and turned, squeaking and taking a step back. "... Ruby Rose..." "Y-Yeah Blake?" Her Faunus friend glared, amber eyes boring into her very soul. Meat sauce clung to her white and black clothes, chunks of beef and mystery meat - at least Ruby assumed it was that, dripped from her hair. Blake's eye twitched and she sighed, wiping away food from her face and flicking it to the ground. "Give me one good reason I shouldn't tell Yang where your cookie stash is right now..." "No, anything but that, please! I'll do anything! Just don't tell her!" "Wait, what?" Blake opened her mouth and Ruby was baffled to hear a bark. Except it wasn't Blake barking - obviously, she was more like a cat anyways. Blake's face went pale at another bark and she glanced over her shoulder, howling and running across the courtyard. Zwei bounded after her, tongue hanging from his mouth and globs of spit dribbling out. Short legs or not he kept pace with the swift Huntress, barking excitedly at a prospective snack. And so ended the not-so-climatic battle between heroes and villains. Some say that the Shadow is still running to this day, fleeing from the might of Zwei: Destroyer of Worlds. "I hate all of you!" Blake screamed, scrambling up a tree and shooing an excited Zwei. Ruby giggled, then hid behind Yang when Blake glowered down at her. She was so dead, wasn't she?

It happened in slow motion, and in that moment Ruby saw her life flash before her eyes. She was too young, too innocent! There was still so much for her to do! Oh wait, Semblances. Ruby wove between the balloons with ease and grinned, standing tall, hands on her hips. "Hah, you missed!" Yang seemed frustrated, then in a surprising twist, horrified. Weiss' eyes were wide and she covered her mouth with her hands, while Nora roared with laughter. What was everyone so shocked about? Ruby tilted her head and turned, squeaking and taking a step back. "... Ruby Rose..." "Y-Yeah Blake?" Her Faunus friend glared, amber eyes boring into her very soul. Meat sauce clung to her white and black clothes, chunks of beef and mystery meat - at least Ruby assumed it was that, dripped from her hair. Blake's eye twitched and she sighed, wiping away food from her face and flicking it to the ground. "Give me one good reason I shouldn't tell Yang where your cookie stash is right now..." "No, anything but that, please! I'll do anything! Just don't tell her!" "Wait, what?" Blake opened her mouth and Ruby was baffled to hear a bark. Except it wasn't Blake barking - obviously, she was more like a cat anyways. Blake's face went pale at another bark and she glanced over her shoulder, howling and running across the courtyard. Zwei bounded after her, tongue hanging from his mouth and globs of spit dribbling out. Short legs or not he kept pace with the swift Huntress, barking excitedly at a prospective snack. And so ended the not-so-climatic battle between heroes and villains. Some say that the Shadow is still running to this day, fleeing from the might of Zwei: Destroyer of Worlds. "I hate all of you!" Blake screamed, scrambling up a tree and shooing an excited Zwei. Ruby giggled, then hid behind Yang when Blake glowered down at her. She was so dead, wasn't she?
